cases.sentence: ___ стала просить у Пилата, чтобы он сделал то, что обычно делал для них.
cases.translation: The crowd began to ask Pilate to do what he usually did for them.
cases.explain: Толпа is the subject of стала просить (began to ask), so it takes the nominative.

cases.sentence: Толпа стала просить у ___, чтобы он сделал то, что обычно делал для них.
cases.translation: The crowd began to ask Pilate to do what he usually did for them.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/from) always takes the genitive → Пилата.

cases.sentence: Они, связав Иисуса, отвели и передали его ___.
cases.translation: Having bound Jesus, they led him away and handed him over to Pilate.
cases.explain: Иосиф купил льняное полотно... he later gave the body to Joseph: отдал тело Иосифу — the recipient of отдал (gave) takes the dative.

cases.sentence: Они одели его в пурпурную ___ и, сплетя венок из терновника, надели на него.
cases.translation: They dressed him in a purple robe and, weaving a crown of thorns, put it on him.
cases.explain: Одеть кого-то в + accusative (dress someone in) — мантию is what he was dressed into.

cases.sentence: Иосиф купил льняное полотно, снял тело, обернул его ___.
cases.translation: Joseph bought a linen cloth, took the body down, and wrapped it in the cloth.
cases.explain: The verb обернуть (wrap) governs the instrumental of the material used → полотном.

cases.sentence: Иисус испустил дух, и завеса в ___ разорвалась надвое, сверху донизу.
cases.translation: Jesus breathed his last, and the curtain in the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.
cases.explain: В (in) marking location, with no motion, takes the prepositional → храме.

reading.ru: Они, связав Иисуса, отвели и передали его Пилату.
reading.question: What did the chief priests and elders do with Jesus early in the morning?
options: Bound him and handed him over to Pilate
Took him to the temple to pray
reading.correct: Bound him and handed him over to Pilate
reading.explain: Early in the morning they bound Jesus, led him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

reading.ru: «Хотите, чтобы я отпустил вам царя иудеев?» — спросил Пилат.
reading.question: What did Pilate ask the crowd during the Passover custom of releasing a prisoner?
options: Whether they wanted him to release the King of the Jews
Whether they wanted him to release Barabbas immediately
Whether they wanted to crucify Barabbas
Whether they wanted a new governor
reading.correct: Whether they wanted him to release the King of the Jews
reading.explain: Pilate asked, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

reading.ru: Пилат, чтобы удовлетворить толпу, освободил им Варавву, а Иисуса отдал на распятие, приказав сперва бичевать его.
reading.question: What did Pilate do to satisfy the crowd?
options: Released Barabbas and handed Jesus over to be flogged and crucified
reading.correct: Released Barabbas and handed Jesus over to be flogged and crucified
reading.explain: To satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas and handed Jesus over to be flogged and crucified.

reading.ru: Они одели его в пурпурную мантию и, сплетя венок из терновника, надели на него.
reading.question: How did the soldiers mock Jesus?
options: They dressed him in a purple robe and put a crown of thorns on him
They made him carry a golden staff
They crowned him with olive branches
reading.correct: They dressed him in a purple robe and put a crown of thorns on him
reading.explain: The soldiers clothed Jesus in purple and wove a crown of thorns for him.

reading.ru: По дороге они остановили человека, шедшего с поля, это был Симон из Кирены, отец Александра и Руфа, и заставили его нести крест.
reading.question: Who was forced to carry Jesus's cross?
reading.explain: The soldiers stopped Simon of Cyrene, coming in from the field, and made him carry the cross.

reading.ru: Они распяли Иисуса, а его одежду разделили между собой, бросая жребий, кому что взять.
reading.question: What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothing?
options: Divided it among themselves by casting lots
reading.correct: Divided it among themselves by casting lots
reading.explain: They crucified Jesus and divided his clothes among themselves by casting lots.

reading.ru: Проходившие мимо бронили его, качая головами они говорили «Ну что? Ты ведь собирался разрушить храм и в три дня отстроить его? Спаси себя! Сойди с креста!»
reading.question: What did people passing by say to mock Jesus on the cross?
options: They told him to save himself and come down from the cross since he claimed he could destroy and rebuild the temple
They told him to pray to the priests for help
They asked him to perform a miracle for money
They asked him why he had come to Jerusalem
reading.correct: They told him to save himself and come down from the cross since he claimed he could destroy and rebuild the temple
reading.explain: Passersby mocked him, saying he should save himself and come down from the cross since he claimed he could destroy and rebuild the temple.

reading.ru: В девятом часу Иисус громко крикнул «Элои, Элои, лема савахтани», что означает «Боже мой, Боже мой, почему ты меня оставил?»
reading.question: What did Jesus cry out at the ninth hour?
options: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
"Into your hands I commit my spirit"
reading.correct: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
reading.explain: At the ninth hour Jesus cried out, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani," which means "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

reading.ru: Иосиф купил льняное полотно, снял тело, обернул его полотном и положил вырубленную в скале гробницу.
reading.question: What did Joseph of Arimathea do with Jesus's body?
options: Wrapped it in linen cloth and laid it in a rock-cut tomb
Buried it in the ground without a shroud
Left it on the cross overnight
reading.correct: Wrapped it in linen cloth and laid it in a rock-cut tomb
reading.explain: Joseph bought a linen cloth, took the body down, wrapped it, and laid it in a tomb cut out of rock.
